observations.code_quote: # Range rewrite emits ``less(col, 'mango') AND notEquals(col, '') AND notEquals(col, 'null')``; ClickHouse considers each AND-ed clause against every applicable index — minmax fires on ``less``, bloom filter fires on the sentinel ``notEquals`` clauses (granules with no ``''`` / ``'null'`` rows trivially satisfy them). Non-numeric bound: numeric text coerces and skips the rewrite.
